description.value: Freshly Squeezed is a juice bar concept located inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre, Kelowna's large indoor mall on Harvey Avenue. Originally founded as 'Orange Cup' serving only freshly squeezed orange juice, the brand has grown into a broader fresh-juice offering. A touring cyclist passing through on the Harvey Avenue corridor can stop here for a cold, freshly pressed drink in a climate-controlled mall environment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the Orchard Park Shopping Centre mall directory page for Freshly Squeezed, confirming it is a juice bar operating inside the mall at 2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna. The phone number (236-420-6787) and address (2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, V1Y 6H2) match OSM exactly. OSM tag takeaway=yes is consistent with the nature of a juice kiosk; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: The website URL resolves to the shopping mall's store directory page (orchardparkshopping.com), not Freshly Squeezed's own brand website. Cyclist-specific amenity information is unavailable from this source.
Store is located inside an indoor shopping mall; bike parking would be at mall exterior entrances, not directly visible from the kiosk.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible juice bar inside a major Kelowna mall on a main cycling corridor; confirmed operating from both OSM and mall website.
